{{Top|leg}}
The '''Farmer's Co-op Council''' was the governing body of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vernet]]. It was a body comprised of elected members, drawn from the world's [[Farm/Legends|farm]] owners. The council ensured fair and equal treatment for the people of Vernet, and negotiated crop prices and import tariffs.<ref name="TD">{{JournalCite|15|The Draw}}</ref>
